comment: HOW THE USER'S POSE SHEET BECOMES THE PROTAGONIST'S FRAMES (docs/ART-PIPELINE-2D.md part L). The sheet (hero-sheet.png, 1536 x 1024, no alpha) is the user's own drawing and is kept here bit for bit: the frames in art/player/hero/ are made FROM it by `npm run assets:poses`, with technical operations only — a transparent background, the figure's pixels untouched, what is not the figure (ground shadow, speed lines, dust, red energy) left out, one pose facing left mirrored so every pose faces right. Nothing is drawn, recoloured or smoothed. Each pose is one rectangle of the sheet; the decisions a person makes (where a pose is, where its feet are, where the sword is held) are in this file, and are checked by looking at the result in ?lab=player.

idle.what: pose 1 of the sheet: standing, calm

jump.what: pose 4: rising (its speed lines are left out)

fall.what: pose 5: falling head first (its speed lines are left out)

land.what: pose 6: the landing crouch (its dust is left out)

slash.what: pose 7: the low lunge with the sword out (its red arc is left out)

hurt.what: pose 11: struck, thrown back (its red sparks are left out)

guard.what: pose 12: the sword raised; drawn facing left in the sheet, mirrored

unused.pose 2: a second standing pose, a three-quarter stance: no state asks for it yet
unused.pose 8: the second blow: the sword and a red arc fused into one drawing; the arc is the effect and cannot be taken out without taking the blade with it
unused.pose 9: the charge: red flames cover the figure
unused.pose 10: the dash: the figure is a red streak

frames.name: dash_00
frames.standIn: the run: the sheet's dash pose is a red streak, not a figure

frames.name: attack2_00
frames.standIn: the first blow: the sheet's second blow cannot be separated from its red arc

frames.name: aerialAttack_00
frames.standIn: the first blow: the sheet has no blow in the air

frames.name: crouch_00
frames.standIn: the landing crouch: the sheet has no crouch

frames.name: crouchAttack_00
frames.standIn: the first blow, a low lunge: the sheet has no blow from the crouch

frames.name: death_00
frames.standIn: the hit: the sheet has no death

frames.name: drink_00
frames.standIn: standing: the sheet has no drinking

frames.name: interact_00
frames.standIn: standing: the sheet has no interaction
